stemMarkdown: By selling an article for Rs. 1575.00, a shopkeeper incurs a loss of 25%. At what price (in Rs.) should he sell it to make a profit of 20%?
solutionMarkdown: A 25% loss means SP is $75\%$ of CP, so CP $= 1575.00 \times \dfrac{100}{75} = 2100$. For a 20% profit, SP $= 2100 \times \dfrac{120}{100} = 2520.0$.
